rng: Python random.Random / MT19937; single stream; preserve code and Python version

rules.rule: Date sampling weights: destination peak=1.7, off-peak=.85; Fri-Sun=1.35 multiplier
rules.bias: Seasonal demand is imposed, not discovered from real observations.

rules.rule: Booking status weights completed=.84, cancelled=.13, no_show=.03
rules.bias: Cancellation rate is synthetic and not causal evidence for channel quality.

rules.rule: Breakfast included for all 5-star rate plans; 3-star inclusion depends on selected channel-specific plan
rules.bias: Any star-breakfast relationship is a business rule, not model accuracy.

rules.rule: Promotion eligibility uses sale/stay/site/channel; eligible bookings use it with probability .65
rules.bias: No randomized control design; incremental campaign revenue cannot be identified.

rules.rule: Cross-sell ticket=.55, rental=.24; customer identifiers differ; legitimate contacts may be missing
rules.bias: Identity truth is excluded from ingestion; no free enterprise customer key.

rules.rule: Weather is synthetic with destination seasonality; affects outdoor closures
rules.bias: Not real weather; weather is not a direct demand model in v1.

rules.rule: No completed room/vehicle interval may overlap occupancy or maintenance
rules.bias: Capacity censoring affects realized booking distribution; report actual generated counts.

rules.rule: Ingredient costs come from linked USE movements times purchase unit price; breakfast/dinner split proportional to covers
rules.bias: Allocation is synthetic; correlation between covers and cost is partly imposed.

rules.rule: Supplier price multipliers .9-1.15, delay .05, rejected unit .08, random waste .08; residual perishable unit expires
rules.bias: Artificial supplier performance; no claim about named real brands.

rules.rule: Outlet quality baseline randomly 2-5 independent of hotel stars; ratings clipped to 1-5
rules.bias: Ratings and wait times do not represent observed service.

limitations: Annual paid membership not automatically renewed; E Family initially records owner only. No detailed point ledger or voucher redemption in v1.
Linked hotel/entertainment sales exist, but full composite package allocation and partial hotel cancellation histories are not yet modeled.
Meal ingredient cost uses an explicit allocation rule; it is not per-customer observed consumption.
Source loading and lake ingestion are full snapshots, not CDC. Original source update histories are not synthesized.
Procurement covers purchase, receipt and stock; full supplier invoice/payment workflows and transfers are reserved for a later version.
evaluation_guidance: Use exact aggregates and integrity invariants for warehouse correctness; do not treat synthetic correlations as business evidence.
Benchmark on multiple versioned seeds/scales; keep data generation outside timed ETL measurements.
Do not tune ETL identity resolution using audit_only truth; use it only in separate evaluation.
Store an untouched holdout scenario/version if evaluating predictive models later.
